answer_2.quote: We use Accuracy and Memorization Ratio (MR) as the main evaluation metrics in our experiment.

answer_4.quote: To label the correctness of MLLMs responses for the open-ended questions, we design our evaluation criteria... The annotators are asked to determine the correctness of MLLMs' responses based on two criteria: Relevancy (0 or 1) and Responsiveness (0 or 1).
answer_4.guideline: determine the correctness of MLLMs' responses based on two criteria: Relevancy and Responsiveness
